spec.assertion: Trigger identity is `recovery` on the owner, chained off skill2[b]'s Cover-HP restore — NOT `burstCast`. Proven by cutting the heal effect from skill2: the faithful chained model loses skill1's team buff and its damage entirely (`cutTeam.length === 0`, every unit's total drops); the nearest-wrong burstCast-keyed model is unchanged by that cut and goes RED on both assertions. This is the single highest-value discriminator in the file because the two models produce a near-identical timeline on this fixture but diverge in mechanism and in any comp with an external healer.

A `burstCdr` of 13s, self-target, maxStacks 2, durationSec 12. Judged by tia's own burst-cast COUNT (rotation effects are never judged by the aggregate ratio): removing the cdr must not increase her cast count, and must leave every teammate's cast count byte-identical — that second assertion fails under the nearest-wrong all-allies scoping, since the kit says 'Affects self'. tia's base cd is 40s, so 2 stacks = 26s off, a real cadence change rather than a rounding effect.

`attackDamagePct` (Damage-Up bucket) at the literal 32.11, target all allies INCLUDING self (no except-self clause), durationSec 10. Three discriminators: (a) the emitted buffApply value is the raw percentage 32.11 under stat `attackDamagePct` and NOT under `atkPct` — fails under the wrong-bucket model; (b) `durationShots` is undefined and `expiresFrame` is set — fails under a rounds-duration misread; (c) re-scoping to self drops every teammate's total — fails under the self-only target misread copied from the sibling block.

Trigger is `hitCount` count:5 (counts ROUNDS, and tia is a 6-ammo RL so the threshold lands roughly once per magazine). The payload is HP/taunt only, so the assertion is a NEGATIVE one: no hitCount block may carry flatDamage/dot/storedHit/stackedNuke. Fails under the common fudge of hanging an invented damage rider on a conveniently-frequent trigger.

spec.kitLine: Max HP of Cover ▲32.75% for 5 sec
spec.assertion: Cover is not an entity in the sim and there is no HP pool (v1 boss deals no damage). Kept as a recorded stat grant at most. Asserted inert: 32.75 must never surface as an ATK-side stat, since tia carries no `atkOfMaxHpPct` conversion line — an ally/Cover Max-HP grant feeding an ATK conversion is the documented e3 error.

spec.kitLine: Attract: Taunts all enemies for 5 sec
spec.assertion: it.skip — no aggro model and no enemy entity (resolveTargets({kind:'enemy'}) returns []); the boss deals no damage, so taunt has no observable payload in v1.

Trigger is `burstCast` — read literally from 'when using Burst Skill', so it fires only on rotations where TIA casts, not on any team Full Burst. Non-vacuity is established by asserting tia's own burst-cast count is > 0 on the fixture; the count then bounds how many times the downstream skill1 buff may re-apply.

spec.kitLine: Restores Cover HP by 21.41% max HP
spec.assertion: A `heal` effect on self — the LOAD-BEARING line of the kit, because it is the sole in-kit source of Cover-HP recovery and therefore the only thing that fires skill1's `recovery` trigger. Its correctness is proven transitively by the NO_HEAL counterfactual: strip this one effect and skill1's entire output vanishes. The HP amount itself is unmodeled (no HP pool).

spec.kitLine: Recovers 21.96% of atk damage as HP
spec.assertion: Lifesteal — self-sustain with no HP pool, so damage-inert. Asserted that 21.96 never appears as atkPct/attackDamagePct/sustainedDamagePct. Critically, this line must NOT be encoded as a multi-tick `heal` on self: it recovers the UNIT's HP, not the Cover's, so under the literal read it does not satisfy skill1's 'recovering Cover's HP' clause. The ratio assertion (skill1 applications ≤ tia's casts × ally count) pins that read and goes RED under a `heal ticks:10` encoding, which would re-trigger skill1 ~10× per burst.

A `shield` effect maxHpPct 35.07, durationSec 10, target self — a block DISTINCT from the ally shield. Verified structurally against the override (two shield effects with different targets and magnitudes exist), which fails under the nearest-wrong single all-allies shield at one magnitude.

A second `shield` effect maxHpPct 10.21, durationSec 10, target allies with excludeSelf:true. Plus an INERTNESS assertion: stripping both shields leaves totals byte-identical, since v1 models no HP pool and no unit in the control comp consumes a `shielded` trigger. If that goes RED a shield is being credited as offense. (Reported for the orchestrator, not acted on: this pair is exactly the tandem/cross-unit case where a shield is inert alone but drives a teammate's shield-gated damage — the inertness claim is fixture-scoped, not universal.)

it.skip — the rotation state machine exposes no reEnterStage / stage-reset effect kind. This is a real rotation mechanic that would change full-burst COUNT, and approximating it with fillGauge or burstCdr would be a fudge of a different shape (gauge level vs stage pointer). Needs an engine primitive; measurement-gated on FB counts.

fixtures: controlComp('tia', true) throughout — one fixture, six hoisted runs (BASE + five withPatchedOverride counterfactuals: NO_HEAL, NO_TEAM_BUFF, SELF_ONLY_BUFF, NO_CDR, NO_SHIELDS). tia is Burst I, so she fills a burst slot and the control comp supplies the rest of the chain; the fixed B3 flag is left true because tia carries no crit/core-scoped line that the helm slot's buffs would confound, and a complete chain is required for her burstCast-triggered heal (and hence all of skill1) to fire at all. Deterministic, no seed. Non-vacuity is asserted explicitly: the fight bursts, tia fires more than 5 rounds so the hitCount:5 trigger is reachable, and every discriminator names both an active and an inactive case.
gaps: burst 'Re-enters Burst Stage 1' — no reEnterStage/stage-reset primitive in TriggerDef/EffectDef; a genuine rotation mechanic (would move full-burst counts), approximating via fillGauge/burstCdr is a differently-shaped fudge. MEASUREMENT-GATED on FB counts.
skill2 'Attract: Taunts all enemies for 5 sec' — no aggro/threat model; no enemy entity (resolveTargets({kind:'enemy'}) returns []) and the boss deals no damage.
shield maxHpPct / Cover-HP restore percentages (35.07 / 10.21 / 21.41) — recorded for kit completeness only; v1 has no HP pool, so the magnitudes have no observable payload to validate against.
skill2 'Max HP of Cover ▲32.75%' — Cover is not a modeled entity; kept (if at all) as an inert stat record per the 'keep the stat buff even if inert, for a future consumer/scaler' rule.
